title: Conditional Type 3
subtitle: Câu điều kiện loại 3 — Không có thật trong quá khứ

meta.prevUnitConnection: Type 2 = giả thuyết hiện tại. Type 3 = hối tiếc về quá khứ.

goalBlock.speaking: Dùng Type 3 trong Part 3 để phân tích sai lầm lịch sử — thể hiện tư duy phân tích sâu, band 6.5+.
goalBlock.writing: Dùng Type 3 trong Task 2 để lập luận nguyên nhân-kết quả trong quá khứ — cấu trúc phức tạp nhất.

theory.coreRule: Conditional Type 3: IF + Past Perfect (had + V3), would/could/might + have + V3. Diễn đạt tình huống KHÔNG CÓ THẬT trong QUÁ KHỨ. Biến thể mệnh đề chính: could have + V3, might have + V3.

grammarForSpeaking.wrong: If countries had acted earlier on climate change, the situation would be much better now.
grammarForSpeaking.correct: If countries had acted earlier on climate change, the situation would have been much better.
grammarForSpeaking.tipVi: Type 3 phải nhất quán: if-clause dùng Past Perfect (had acted) → mệnh đề chính dùng would HAVE + V3. 'Would be' là Type 2 — trộn hai loại là lỗi phổ biến.
grammarForSpeaking.bandImpact: Dùng đúng Type 3 hoàn chỉnh là dấu hiệu Grammatical Range band 6.5–7.0.

quickExamples.en: If earlier generations had prioritized environmental protection, we would not have faced such severe climate crises.
quickExamples.vi: Nếu các thế hệ trước đã ưu tiên bảo vệ môi trường, chúng ta đã không phải đối mặt với khủng hoảng khí hậu nghiêm trọng.

quickExamples.en: The 2008 financial crisis could have been avoided if regulators had imposed stricter controls.
quickExamples.vi: Cuộc khủng hoảng 2008 đã có thể tránh được nếu cơ quan quản lý áp đặt kiểm soát chặt chẽ hơn.

quickExamples.en: Millions of lives might have been saved if international aid had reached affected regions sooner.
quickExamples.vi: Hàng triệu sinh mạng đã có thể được cứu nếu viện trợ quốc tế đến sớm hơn.

commonMistakes.incorrect: If they had prepared better, they would avoid the crisis.
commonMistakes.correct: If they had prepared better, they would have avoided the crisis.
commonMistakes.explanationVi: Type 3 phải nhất quán: if + had + V3, would + HAVE + V3. Không dùng 'would avoid' (Type 2).

commonMistakes.incorrect: If the treaty would have been signed earlier, more countries could participate.
commonMistakes.correct: If the treaty had been signed earlier, more countries could have participated.
commonMistakes.explanationVi: If-clause Type 3: 'had been signed' (không 'would have been'). Mệnh đề chính: could have participated.

commonMistakes.incorrect: The disaster might avoided if the government has warned citizens earlier.
commonMistakes.correct: The disaster might have been avoided if the government had warned citizens earlier.
commonMistakes.explanationVi: Mệnh đề chính: might + have + been + V3. If-clause: had + V3. Hai vế phải nhất quán.

items.question: Câu Conditional Type 3 nào đúng?
options: If the UN had intervened sooner, the conflict would be prevented.
If the UN had intervened sooner, the conflict would have been prevented.
If the UN would have intervened sooner, the conflict would be prevented.
If the UN intervened sooner, the conflict would have been prevented.
items.correctAnswer: If the UN had intervened sooner, the conflict would have been prevented.
items.feedbackCorrect: Đúng! Type 3: if + had intervened (Past Perfect) + would have been prevented (Passive would + have + V3).
items.feedbackWrong: Type 3: if + Past Perfect (had + V3) + would have + V3. Cả hai vế phải dùng 'have'. Không dùng 'would have' trong mệnh đề if.
items.ieltsTip: Dấu hiệu nhận biết Type 3: 'had + V3' trong mệnh đề if, 'would/could/might + have + V3' trong mệnh đề chính.

items.question: Câu Task 2 nào phân tích đúng nguyên nhân khủng hoảng 2008?
options: The 2008 crisis could be avoided if banks would have been regulated more strictly.
The 2008 crisis could have been avoided if banks had been regulated more strictly.
The 2008 crisis could have been avoided if banks were regulated more strictly.
The 2008 crisis would avoid if banks had been regulated more strictly.
items.correctAnswer: The 2008 crisis could have been avoided if banks had been regulated more strictly.
items.feedbackCorrect: 'Could have been avoided' = Passive Type 3. 'Had been regulated' = Past Perfect Passive trong if-clause. Câu Task 2 phân tích lịch sử band 6.5!
items.feedbackWrong: Type 3 + Passive: mệnh đề chính = could/would + have + been + V3. If-clause = had + been + V3. Không dùng 'would have' trong if-clause.
items.ieltsTip: Type 3 + Passive: 'could have been [prevented/avoided] if [subject] had [done something]' — phổ biến trong Task 2 phân tích lịch sử.

items.question: Sửa lỗi: 'If colonial powers had not exploited developing nations, those countries might have develop stronger economies. Many global inequalities would not existed today.'
options: might have develop → might have developed; would not existed → would not have existed
might have develop → might developed; would not existed đúng
Chỉ might have develop → might have developed
Câu đúng, không cần sửa.
items.correctAnswer: might have develop → might have developed; would not existed → would not have existed
items.feedbackCorrect: Hai lỗi: (1) 'might have develop' → 'might have developed' (modal + have + V3). (2) 'would not existed' → 'would not have existed' (thiếu 'have').
items.feedbackWrong: Type 3 mệnh đề chính: modal + have + V3. 'Might have develop' thiếu -d. 'Would not existed' thiếu 'have'.
items.ieltsTip: Lỗi phổ biến Type 3: quên 'have' sau modal: 'would existed' → 'would have existed'. Luôn kiểm tra: modal + HAVE + V3.

items.question: Điền đúng: 'If global leaders _____ (take) decisive action on inequality in the 1990s, the wealth gap we see today _____ (might / not / become) so extreme.'
options: had taken / might not have become
had taken / might not become
would have taken / might not have become
had taken / might not became
items.correctAnswer: had taken / might not have become
items.feedbackCorrect: 'Had taken' = Past Perfect trong if-clause. 'Might not have become' = modal + not + have + V3. Type 3 hoàn chỉnh!
items.feedbackWrong: If-clause: had + V3 (had taken — không 'would have taken'). Main clause: might + not + have + V3 (become — V3 của become = become).
items.ieltsTip: V3 của 'become' = 'become' (giống V1). Nên 'might have become' đúng, không phải 'might have became'.

items.question: Tạo câu Task 2: [invested / developed / nations / had / clean / in / energy / earlier / carbon / emissions / would / significantly / have / fallen]
options: If developed nations had invested in clean energy earlier, carbon emissions would have fallen significantly.
If developed nations would have invested in clean energy earlier, carbon emissions would have fallen significantly.
If developed nations had invested in clean energy earlier, carbon emissions would fallen significantly.
Developed nations had invested in clean energy earlier, carbon emissions would have fallen significantly.
items.correctAnswer: If developed nations had invested in clean energy earlier, carbon emissions would have fallen significantly.
items.feedbackCorrect: Type 3 hoàn hảo! If + had invested (Past Perfect — không 'would have invested') + would have fallen (would + have + V3, V3 của fall = fallen). Band 7.0!
items.feedbackWrong: If-clause: had invested (không 'would have invested'). Main clause: would + have + fallen (V3 của fall = fallen).
items.ieltsTip: Type 3 Task 2: 'If [subject] had [V3], [result] would have [V3].' Dùng trong kết bài phân tích nguyên nhân lịch sử.

writingMini.prompt: Viết 1-2 câu Task 2 dùng Type 3 phân tích sai lầm lịch sử. Chủ đề: môi trường hoặc kinh tế.
writingMini.placeholder: Ví dụ: If world governments had signed a binding climate agreement in the 1990s...
writingMini.modelAnswer: If world governments had signed a binding climate agreement in the 1990s, global temperatures would not have risen as dramatically, and the costs of climate adaptation would have been far lower.

speakingDrill.prompt: Part 3: 'What could the international community have done differently to prevent current global problems?' Dùng Type 3.
speakingDrill.modelAnswer: If earlier generations had taken climate change more seriously, we would not have faced the environmental crises we see today. Governments could have invested in renewable energy decades ago, creating a much cleaner economy. Had international cooperation been stronger, many of today's conflicts might have been avoided entirely.
